overview: The Cannabis Advisory Committee voted to forward Kindly Cannabis Delivery's scored application to the mayor and authorized En Route to move forward with a public community meeting for its proposed delivery operation.

items.title: Kindly Cannabis Delivery Application Review
items.summary: The committee reviewed scoring for Kindly Cannabis Delivery's proposed delivery service at 86 Swan Street and voted to forward the application to the mayor for host community agreement consideration.

items.title: En Route Delivery Presentation
items.summary: En Route presented its proposal to operate an all-electric cannabis delivery business out of 151 Mystic Avenue, and the committee voted to allow the applicant to proceed to a public community meeting.

items.title: Public Participation and Correspondence
items.summary: Schrader noted neighborhood correspondence citing parking and roadway concerns regarding the Swan Street proposal, and explained the municipal ordinance governing committee review in response to a public question.
